title: I started making my first horror game – looking for feedback on the menu
author: Hunter-8262
selftext:
I’m still very early in the development of my first horror investigation game, but I’ve finished the main menu and added some background music to set the mood.

I’d really appreciate some honest feedback from other game developers and players.

Does the menu feel like it fits a horror investigation game? Is the atmosphere working, or is there anything you think I should change?

This is my first game, so I’m trying to learn as I go. Any feedback, criticism, or suggestions would be really helpful.

I’ll share the menu screenshot/video below. Thanks!

comments.author: Reign2294
comments.body: Idk why you got downvotes. I think the menu is clean.

comments.author: EmergencyPath248
comments.body:
Good UI, however I think the case files images you have there look like "AI SLOP" and would be noticable to any players.

Expensive, but perhaps make an AI so a SVG of it like astra. Gives it that artistic look
